cancelled_withdrawal_amount.meaning: _cancelledWithdrawalAmount value recorded on cancelWithdrawal and read by redelegateWithdrawnHYPE
cancelled_withdrawal_amount.checkpoint: before redelegateWithdrawnHYPE reads and resets it

remainder_nonzero.meaning: _cancelledWithdrawalAmount has a nonzero remainder modulo 1e10 wei HYPE

stranded_hype_untracked.meaning: stranded HYPE remainder is neither recorded in totalStaked, tracked in hypeBuffer, nor delegated to validators

assumptions: The truncated remainder is less than 1e10 wei HYPE (less than 1e-8 HYPE).
redelegateWithdrawnHYPE reads _cancelledWithdrawalAmount and resets it to zero before re-delegation.
The re-delegation path uses _distributeStake with OperationType.SpotDeposit and _convertTo8Decimals(amount, false).

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether a nonzero remainder scenario was actually observed; it is a conditional possibility.
Exact location of stranded HYPE (contract ETH balance vs L1 account) is described as implementation-dependent.

limitations: Formalizes only the untracked/undelegated stranded-remainder impact; other impacts (permanent lock, reduced kHYPE profits) are handled in separate passes.
stranded_hype_untracked is a report-grounded Boolean because the report states the untracked/undelegated condition without a numeric accounting definition.

The remainder modulo 1e10 relation is represented via the report-grounded remainder_nonzero Boolean rather than a divisible_by predicate, since the impact concerns the untracked remainder rather than a divisibility check.
